text:
olivia: quick check before the review: we need a minimal GA acceptance that ties directly to customer risk. proposing three lanes: interactive (latency), bulk embeddings (cost/throughput), regulated pilots (security/support).

ben: agree. interactive: steady p99 < 250ms, spike tolerance p99 < 600ms for short bursts. we should require perf traces for at least 2 customer patterns.

rita: bulk embeddings acceptance: end-to-end cost per 1M embedding ops under target and quota enforcement in billing sandbox. also confirm cache effectiveness >=50% on sample datasets.

dave: regulated pilots: require deployment checklist (KMS config + audit logging) and 2-week SE onboarding window. also rollback plan documented.

launch-bot: reminder: Launch Readiness Review starts in 10 minutes.

olivia: owners: ben -> perf traces + bench infra, rita -> cost/billing dry-run, dave -> security checklist + pilot runbook. my call: gate GA for non-regulated customers; label compliance-ready post-cert. thumbs if you accept. :thumbsup:

ben: :thumbsup:

rita: :thumbsup:

dave: :thumbsup: will add rollback steps to the runbook.
